questions.q: In "Measure and build the water balance Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Measure flows: time how long a bucket of known volume takes to fill at each tap and shower. Flow = volume divided by time.
Meter readings: 4,210 m3 to 4,214 m3 in 10 days = 4 m3 = 4000 litres, i.e. 400 litres a day.
Update the plan.
Shower flow: 9-litre bucket fills in 45 s = 12 litres per minute. 8 minutes = 96 litres per shower.
